method.evaluation: Compare exact sentence and changed-word selection. Assess the separate developer-defined report generators and dated ordinary journal revisions. Truth is reproducible changed wording, not a label for authorship of individual words. Word success requires at least 50 percent recall and 30 percent intersection over union of changed words. Report false and misplaced alerts.
method.head: Concatenate each token representation and its difference from the mean lexical representation within its sentence. Fit a linear head with token BCE plus a paired margin over the edited words and the six strongest corresponding original-center words.
method.selection: Use the six strongest averaged word scores to rank each interior sentence. A unique winning sentence may be marked. Compare highlighting that sentence with retaining its top 60 percent of scored words. Fit both alert points on the separate genuine report files, before held inference.
method.training: Start at the pinned Apache-2.0 encoder. Fit on original and generated report excerpts. Label only submitted words within the known changed sentence that are outside a monotonic exact-word alignment. Use inverse token-piece counts to give each word equal supervised weight.
